cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Recruit Them Twice
cards.instruction: Recruit them to your side, then reveal that the side, goal, or conflict is not what it first appeared to be.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Join my campaign to save the club garden. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Our extension plan. The one we both signed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We know the opposition's weaknesses. Will you join the honest version?

mechanism: A leads garden defence then recruits B against their own signed extension plan, yielding presentation control to retain B support.
confusable: Self-criticism alone lacks the second recruitment after the true opposing side is revealed.
comparison: Cupboard scene recruits a helper against another official; garden scene makes A and B jointly accountable for their own plan.
seedUse: Garden seed supplies the self-opposition reveal; S02 changes the public admission arrangement in response to B reputational concern.
